name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 6 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2025-07-24, at wavelengths from 1.15 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
